title: Analyze library-product impact, product authority, and boundary leases
description: Inventory the one-turn CLI lifecycle, legacy baselines, sibling services, CommonFeatureFlags obligations, Schema Universal receipts, contextual carriers, optional depot, backward compatibility, accepted Vaporize product contract, implementation steward, exact Git boundary, staged source-access decisions, closed worker and runtime operations, independent authority planes, and required capability finalizers before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Name sibling services and WarehouseKit's four obligations; prove default OFF and no-option equivalence; resolve a non-empty exact required boundary set, the product owner, Vaporize repository owner, delivery owner, environment policy-plane owners, their independent delegation and issuer receipts, implementation steward, Git boundary, read roots, write roots, approved build/test commands, commit scope, governance.write roots, and the closed delivery.execute, feature.policy.write, feature.exposure.execute, rollback.execute, credential.use, network.connect, vcs.push, and release.publish operations; define an idempotent non-success finalizer for every lease issuer; prove no-option behavior performs no depot/network/product lookup or resolution change and that no authority plane implies another.
